$comment: Reviewed, intentional differences from the golden baseline, read by tests/e2e/route-inventory.spec.ts. Only soft fields can be approved: description, keywords, og:title, og:description, og:image:alt, og:site_name, og:locale, og:type, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image:alt. Shape: routes["/path"]["field"] = { "value": "exact new text" | null (removed), "reason": "why" }. Hard fields (title, canonical, og:url, robots, OG image, anchors, JSON-LD coverage, EnquiryRouter intent, print hooks, headers, sitemap order, redirects) cannot be approved here. An approval that matches the baseline again fails as stale. The top-level "visible" list is a review log, not read by the tests: every intentional change to visible page copy, link targets or a recorded deviation from the design spec, as { routes, change, reason }.

visible.reason: C0: the plan's 'Call · WhatsApp · Enquire'; the mailto: action stays for conversion tracking and the QuickContact contract.

visible.reason: The no-split rule for 'Tanzania–Zambia' takes precedence: the compound is about 7.6em wide and must fit the 316px line; the h1 still leads every other heading by 1.2x or more.

visible.change: Hero actions are now 'Route an enquiry' (the page's own form, #enquire) and 'Group profile (PDF)' (the group profile download), followed by six service shortcuts (icon and short title) that jump to each row of the capability map.
visible.reason: P5 (Apple support-style page): the pill goes to the form on the page (PAGE-GUIDE §1), the capability statement PDF is the page's strongest proof, and the shortcuts replace a photograph in a typographic hero.

visible.change: Verification signals: the four numbered cards become a bento with evidence in each cell: the three companies with their sectors (links to their pages) under 'The operating companies', 'See who runs each service ›' (#capability-map), 'How enquiries move ›' (/partnerships#how-enquiries-move), and the head-office address with the UZUNGUNI PARKING YARD truck-line photograph.
visible.reason: P5: the task's verification-signals bento; each signal now shows what it claims. The page's one photograph is a crisp, non-canopy operations frame in a small cell (1280px master).

visible.change: Capability map rows drop the service eyebrow and the long company summary; the company is named by its short name with its accent dot, and the first three audiences are plain lines instead of pills.
visible.reason: P5: a spec-table row per service (what it covers, who runs it, who asks) instead of three dense columns; the company summary repeats its own page one click away.

visible.change: Due-diligence path becomes the page's cinema tile: a typographic panel ('The company profile is written for banks and partners.' / 'The group profile and a profile for each company, ready to download.'), the checklist under 'Have these ready', and the two profile buttons as chevron links.
visible.reason: P5: the owner photo rule (a typographic tile where no strong photograph exists); the statement is the approved core message (institution-ready profile), and one pill per screen.

visible.change: Beside the form, a legend 'Which option to choose' lists the four enquiry types (General, Mwanjalisi Oil, Westsides, Itemba Enterprises) with what each covers.
visible.reason: P5: the page promises 'Contact the right team'; the legend (from enquiryIntents) says which option to pick, as the company template sets its steps beside the form.

visible.change: Hero actions are now 'Route an enquiry' (#enquire) and 'See capabilities ›' (/capabilities), followed by four route shortcuts (Suppliers, Bulk buyers, Fuel & logistics, Property & hospitality) that jump to the new card anchors #suppliers, #bulk-buyers, #fuel-logistics and #property-hospitality.
visible.reason: P5 (Apple support-style page): the pill goes to the form on the page; the shortcuts replace a photograph in a typographic hero.

visible.reason: P5: partnershipAreas[].intentId (unused on origin/main) now names the option to pick; the page stays static, so the form is not preselected (the optional ?intent= preselect was not built).

visible.change: 'How enquiries move' becomes the page's cinema tile, anchored #how-enquiries-move: an h2 'From first message to follow-up.', a one-line explanation under each of the four verbatim steps, and a typographic panel 'One group office routes every enquiry to the right company.' with the three company names.
visible.reason: P5: the task's four-step strip given room of its own; the panel statement is the approved core message; the step lines restate existing facts (FAQ: the group office reviews and routes each enquiry).

visible.change: The form moves from the sticky aside beside the routes to the closing section (after the questions), with 'Partnership enquiry' / 'Ready to talk to Itemba Group?', a one-sentence routing promise, and the partner checklist under 'What to include'.
visible.reason: P5: the company-template enquiry layout (promise and checklist on the left, the full form on the right); the checklist is the capability page's partner checklist, shown where it is used.

visible.change: Deviation: both heroes are typographic (no photograph).
visible.reason: Owner photo rule: every 2000px landscape master is a forecourt canopy; no non-canopy photograph is wide enough to lead a hero. The shortcut rows carry the heroes instead, as on Apple Support.
